items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: And I can tell you it was Roland Prince on guitar and Don Pullen on organ, Bucky Thorpe on flugelhorn and Bobby Battle from Detroit on drums. And I did that for a year.

ctx.x: This is not a blues gig.

Exactly. But it is for guitars. So what happened was each weekend this Jazzmania, Mike Morgenstern, who has a venue down in Miami actually, Mike would hire. He was a tenor player, is a tenor player. But he would hire the most, whoever the player was that was available that weekend so from Walter Bishop Junior to Jackie Byard to oh my God to Ronnie Mathews to Kenny Barron, to Don Pullen oh Jesus God, I mean the bassists, the drummers. I mean it was like this major plethora of awesome players and Ronnie Mathews,…

Working with all those established piano players must have increased your already developed hearing because Don Pullen is not going to play all the same changes that Walter Bishop Junior is even though the tune may be the same. Did you find that you followed them when they went to different places or did you try to like just stick to what you knew?
